explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/115 (Eremenko–Lempert): for every ε > 0 and all large n, every monic p of degree n with {|p| ≤ 1} connected satisfies |p'(z)| ≤ (1/2+ε)n² on that set. The page does not say 'monic', but its remarks assume it ('≥ n with equality iff p = z^n'), and the EHP setting requires it. Without it the claim fails, since p = cz^n gives max |p'| = n·c^{1/n} → ∞ as c → ∞. Adding p.Monic is therefore the correct reading.
